title: proactive-autorollback-workflow-for-canary-ab-shadow-rollouts
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Adds a proactive automated rollback workflow that enables staged canary, A/B, and shadow rollouts to quarantine and automatically roll back a model variant when multi-metric safety thresholds are violated. Includes observability, e2e tests, and a manual override UI.
description:
Motivation: We need a proactive autorollback workflow that works across canary, A/B, and shadow rollout modes. Previous autorollback logic was reactive and scoped to single-metric failures; operators requested multi-metric quorum, a short quarantine probing stage, and explicit manual override hooks to safely protect production traffic without delaying rollouts. This PR implements a new workflow orchestration module, metric quorum evaluator, quarantine stage, and UI/observability surfaces to make automated rollback behavior predictable and auditable.

Design summary: The new autorollback engine sits in the rollout controller and evaluates candidate variants against a configurable set of metrics (latency p95, error_rate, regressions on quality evals). A metric quorum rule requires N of M metrics to cross configured thresholds within a sliding window to trigger quarantine. During quarantine we route a reduced percentage of traffic to the candidate and run additional probing probes; if failures persist for a second window, the controller initiates an automatic rollback. Manual-override endpoints allow operators to pause/force-rollback/force-promote. The engine supports canary, weighted A/B, and shadow rollout types.

feat(metrics): composite metric evaluator and quorum matcher

docs: rollout strategy and config schema documentation
review_comments: Kenji Sato: Generally LGTM; two concerns: (1) please make metric thresholds configurable by rollout (not only global), (2) add more defensive guardrails for missing telemetry (NaN handling) — see inline comments.
Priya Shah: Addressed (1) and (2) — added per-rollout metric_overrides and added NaN/counter reset handling in metric_evaluator.py. Also added unit tests for missing telemetry cases.
Laura Chen: Can you clarify expected cost impact of extra probes? Request a short note in the PR and an estimate in the release docs.
Priya Shah: Added a section in docs estimating probe traffic increase (~0.5-2% depending on quarantine percent) and CPU/memory impact observed in our test cluster.
Ravi Patel: Can we ensure the UI shows the exact metric quorum that triggered the quarantine for auditing? Suggest adding events to telemetry and exposing in rollout timeline.
Priya Shah: Added rollout.quarantine.metrics payload and updated console timeline to display the top-level reason and contributing metrics. Added e2e assertion to check presence of the event.
Laura Chen: Approved pending CI e2e flakes fixed.
CI: e2e tests flaked on first run (timing-sensitive), rerun passed, marking green.
Laura Chen: Merged via squash merge after green CI and final approval.
notes: This change centralizes autorollback policy evaluation and should make rollouts safer by default when teams opt into proactive mode. Operator docs include instructions to tune quorum thresholds and disable autorollback per-service.
observability_changes: Added metrics: rollout.quarantine.start, rollout.quarantine.end, rollout.autorollback.triggered and new dashboard template rollout-quarantine.json. Alerts: added a PagerDuty alert when >3 autorollbacks in a 24h window.
docs_updated: redwood/docs/rollouts/proactive_autorollback.md and console rollout UI docs updated. Included rollout config examples and recommended defaults for metric quorum and window sizes.
